summary_en: Meiji Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 12 million shares (4.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥40.0 billion through on-exchange purchases from November 13, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Most acquired shares are planned for cancellation.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Meiji Holdings' Board of Directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition program under the Company Law. The company will acquire up to 12 million shares, representing 4.4% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum outlay of ¥40.0 billion. Purchases will be conducted through on-exchange market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, beginning November 13, 2026 and concluding by March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while maintaining financial stability and reducing cost of capital. The program supports Meiji Holdings' commitment to a total shareholder return ratio of 50% or higher annually under its current three-year medium-term management plan, which emphasizes the evolution of "ROESG Management" and sustainable increases in dividend per share.

A substantial portion of the acquired treasury stock is scheduled to be cancelled pursuant to a separate Board resolution, in accordance with Company Law Article 178. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 11,022,507 treasury shares, with 271,177,493 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
